highlights: Owned architecture and backend development of ServiceAgent, including authentication, platform modules and service integrations.
Built a centralized authentication platform using JWT authentication and rotating CSRF tokens for secure multi-service communication.
Built a reusable multi-calendar scheduling package inspired by Cal.com with timezone-aware booking and isolated multi-tenant databases.
Designed reusable backend packages across services to standardize workflows and improve engineering velocity.
Led backend architecture discussions and deployment planning for scalable TypeScript/NestJS distributed systems.
Built distributed backend systems using TypeScript, NestJS, Redis and event-driven design patterns.
Led ABDM/ABHA/HPR/HFR healthcare integrations for DRx platform under National Health Authority initiatives.
Designed scalable backend workflows supporting multi-clinic and multi-doctor operational models with reusable service abstractions and asynchronous processing patterns.
Implemented scalable backend design patterns including Callback Pattern and Facade Pattern to improve modularity and reusability.
Worked on Tookan, a large-scale logistics and delivery management platform used globally for workforce and operations management.
Designed and developed ACL systems to provide granular access control across derived but independent business entities.
Integrated backend services with POS systems, payment gateways, accounting platforms and eCommerce services.
